purpose: Fallback estimates for recent wellness dates where Garmin steps/calorie fields are null. These are estimates, not Garmin-observed values.
method: Point estimates anchored to the user's recent Garmin resting-calorie baseline (~1858-1860 kcal/day), recorded activities, known travel/activity context, and known 2026-08-18 step count. Do not overwrite observed Garmin values when they become available.
